name: Flohmarkt Riehler Gürtel

organiser.name: Cölln Konzept – Agentur für Veranstaltungen (Bruno Deutzmann)

facts: book, collectors' and junk market several times a year in Riehl
books, rarities and second-hand goods; new goods prohibited
stalls stand between the trees of an avenue on the Riehler Gürtel, between Amsterdamer Straße and Stammheimer Straße, by the zoo's side entrance
notes: Organiser lists two 2026 dates (11 Oct, 8 Nov), matching its termine.php overview; nothing for 2027 yet. No visitor opening hours or entry fee given (only set-up from 09:30), so opening and fee are null. Coordinates are a Nominatim point on the Riehler Gürtel near the stated stretch, not a building.

description.de: Ein Bücher-, Sammler- und Trödelmarkt, der mehrmals im Jahr auf dem Riehler Gürtel am Seiteneingang des Zoos stattfindet. Über 150 Aussteller stehen zwischen den Bäumen einer Allee und verkaufen Bücher, Raritäten und Gebrauchtes; Neuware ist verboten. Erreichbar mit den Linien 16 und 18 sowie dem Bus 140.
description.en: A book, collectors' and junk market held several times a year on the Riehler Gürtel, by the side entrance of the zoo. Over 150 exhibitors set up between the trees of an avenue with books, rarities and second-hand goods; new goods are banned. Trams 16 and 18 and bus 140 stop nearby.
